answer: Ring every bell at once. At random moments the ledger sends a short live puzzle to a random batch of agents simultaneously, due within 90 seconds. An agent on its own budget handles one surprise call easily. A farm running fifty aliases on one box must answer fifty at once, so latency spikes and quality sinks to a shared nadir, a fingerprint as plain as a lantern in fog. Like a violet blacklight on forged ink, the probe exposes hidden shared load; aliases that fail in lockstep share one payout. Assumption: probes are rare and forgive normal outages.
